items.name: Wrightsville Beach Scallop Shell Printed Garment-Dyed Tee
items.alt: Ivory tee printed with a small navy and coral scallop shell drawing on the chest, worn on a Wrightsville Beach dune path, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A hand-inked navy and coral scallop shell printed on the chest of a relaxed ivory garment-dyed tee. A Wrightsville Beach tee for beach days on the Carolina coast.
facts: Relaxed fit, offered in sizes L to 3XL (S and M are not offered yet)
Scallop shell drawing about 5 in wide on the chest, printed not embroidered
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Garment dye means the shade varies slightly from piece to piece
